# Fullmedia Alchemist

> Fullmedia Alchemist turns a website into finished social media posts. Paste your site once; it learns the brand (what you do, who it's for, tone, true facts, colours, logo), then writes and designs each post: caption, 4-5 hashtags and a branded image or carousel with a QR code to your link. It only uses facts your site or you provide and never invents details. Made by United Press Media (https://unitedpress.media).

## How it works
- Try it free on the homepage: paste a website and get one draft post (headline, caption, hashtags) written only from that page. No sign-up; 3 previews a day.
- Brand setup: paste a website, one click. Every detail stays editable.
- Campaigns: describe what to post about in a sentence; choose single images, carousels or a mix. New posts arrive sealed and you reveal them.
- Review: approve, edit, redo with a note, change a link (QR codes redraw). Each post shows checks before you approve: platform length limits (X 280 characters, Instagram 2,200 characters and 5 hashtags, LinkedIn 3,000), missing image or caption, and whether its link opens.
- Posting: you post it yourself (copy caption, download images), then tick the platforms it went out on and add live links and results. No direct scheduler connection yet. Posts can be added to any calendar (.ics), and reminder emails arrive the day before and the day a post is due.
- Learning: a Knowledge Base per brand learns from approvals, redo notes and results; "Review my top posts" suggests campaigns built on what worked.
- Characters: optional new scenes or poses of the brand's own mascot in each post.
- Client approval links (Agency plan): share a campaign with a client, who approves each post or asks for changes without an account.
- Progress: ranks, badges, weekly quests and a posting streak, all counted from real activity (only posts with a live link count toward quests and streaks).
- The Alchemist assistant suggests campaign ideas and sharpens captions.

## Credits (equivalent exchange)
- 1 credit = 1 slide on the Fast model (Pro 2, Max 4). A single-image post on Fast costs 1 credit; a 3-slide carousel costs 3. A new character picture adds 2.
- Credits for images or character pictures that fail are returned automatically.
- Video is coming soon and will cost more credits.

## Plans (USD per month)
- Free: $0, 1 brand, 30 credits/month (up to 10 every 6 hours)
- Starter: $25 ($250/year), 1 brand, 300 credits/month (up to 60 every 6 hours)
- Growth: $99 ($990/year), up to 3 brands, 1,500 credits/month (up to 200 every 6 hours)
- Agency: $599 ($5,990/year), up to 10 brands, 10,000 credits/month (up to 1,000 every 6 hours), client approval links
- Annual billing: 2 months free. Free redos per post: 1 / 2 / 3 / 5 (Free / Starter / Growth / Agency), then a redo costs credits like a new post.
- Review & Improve (the Alchemist reviews posts that went out on a platform): not on Free; Starter 1 platform a month, Growth 3, Agency unlimited.
- Video: coming soon, not available on any plan yet.
